About Me

A quick snapshot and the story behind my work and passions.

About me in 30 seconds

  • Marketing & Growth Specialist with 8+ years of engineering & conversion optimization experience
  • Full-Stack Web Development enthusiast working with JavaScript, Node, React, and Astro
  • Father & Husband living in beautiful Vancouver, BC
  • A big Johnny Cash enthusiast

About me in detail

Hello, my name is Mateus – or Mat for short. I've heard so many variants of my name spoken in different languages that I find it easier to just introduce myself using the first three letters of my name.

I've been working as a CRO specialist and growth hacker at Wishpond, where I became responsible for maintaining the company's blog and marketing website (powered by Ghost and WordPress). And that's where my passion for web development truly started.

Ever since, I haven't stopped programming in my spare time. I've built WordPress sites, micro-services, and custom web apps. I find myself using JavaScript and TypeScript most of the time, in both frontend and backend (much love Node! ✊).

This website itself is a project born out of that passion – built to share apps I'm working on, languages I'm exploring, and insights at the intersection of engineering and digital marketing.

I'm originally from a country region in the state of São Paulo, Brazil 🇧🇷. My academic and professional journey has been based in Vancouver, BC, where I currently reside with my wife and two boys.

In my free time, you'll often find me coaching my older son with his soccer skills, playing guitar, biking around the city with my family, or gaming.
